name: tt-bio-bringup
description: A Claude Code skill that ports a PyTorch biomolecular model to Tenstorrent hardware inside a tt-bio fork: parity-verified against a CPU golden, optimized against a measured roofline, then packaged and gated like the models already shipped. Needs only a PyTorch reference implementation and Tenstorrent cards; no GPU is used at any point.
author: moritztng
